title: comparanda analysis, schema version 1
description: A structured comparison: alternatives x criteria, with qualified missingness, confidence, evidence references to spans, and no default aggregation. This is the INPUT shape -- what a producer must emit. Fields with a default are not required here and are present after parsing, so a consumer reading a parsed analysis will see more than this schema demands. Shape only: the rules a shape cannot express (a value with no justification, a blank whose code the document never defines, an undated verdict) are the honesty family of validateAnalysis, and a document that satisfies this schema can still fail them.
